title: Blackslex and Showering
statementMd:
*After his IMO medalist friend showered for two hours so that "he doesn't have to shower this again this week," Blackslex will be late for class!*

In order to get to class, Blackslex must take the crowded elevator to many floors in a certain order. Because he is a hacker, he can skip visiting up to one floor without the other people knowing. His *time taken* is the sum of the absolute differences between consecutive floor numbers. Find the minimum *time taken*, given that he can skip up to one floor.

More formally, given an array a=[a1,a2,…,an] of n integers, you can choose up to one index k∈{1,2,…,n} to erase such that the sum n−2∑i=1|bi−bi+1| is minimized, where b=[a1,…,ak−1,ak+1,…,an] is the array after erasing element ak. Report the minimum sum.

## Input

The first line contains one integer t (1≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains one integer n (3≤n≤2⋅105) — the size of the array.

The second line contains n integers a1,a2,…,an (1≤ai≤100).

It is guaranteed that the sum of n does not exceed 2⋅105 over all test cases.

## Output

For each test case, output a single real number — the minimum *time taken*.

## Note

For the first test case, one optimal index to remove from [4,15,1,7,9] is k=2. The array becomes [4,1,7,9] and the *time taken* is 11. For the second test case, the optimal index to remove is k=3.
statementZhMd:
*在他的 IMO 奖牌得主朋友为了“这周就不用再洗澡了”而洗了整整两个小时的澡之后，Blackslex 上课要迟到了！*

为了赶到教室，Blackslex 必须乘坐拥挤的电梯按某种顺序前往多个楼层。由于他是一名黑客，他可以在不被其他人发现的情况下跳过至多一个楼层不去。他的*耗时*是相邻楼层编号之差的绝对值之和。在至多可以跳过一个楼层的前提下，求最小的*耗时*。

更形式化地，给定一个由 n 个整数组成的数组 a=[a1,a2,…,an]，你可以选择至多一个下标 k∈{1,2,…,n} 并将其删除，使得和式 n−2∑i=1|bi−bi+1| 最小，其中 b=[a1,…,ak−1,ak+1,…,an] 是删除元素 ak 后得到的数组。请输出这个最小的和。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 t（1≤t≤104）—— 表示测试数据组数。

每组测试数据的第一行包含一个整数 n（3≤n≤2⋅105）—— 表示数组的大小。

第二行包含 n 个整数 a1,a2,…,an（1≤ai≤100）。

保证所有测试数据的 n 之和不超过 2⋅105。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试数据，输出一个单独的实数 —— 即最小的*耗时*。

## 说明

对于第一组测试数据，从 [4,15,1,7,9] 中删除的一个最优下标是 k=2。数组变为 [4,1,7,9]，此时*耗时*为 11。对于第二组测试数据，最优的删除下标是 k=3。
